privacyPolicy.title: Privacy Policy
privacyPolicy.content:
Privacy Policy

Version v1.0 — Effective from 18/09/2026

This Privacy Policy is provided by Christos Pamporis (PEST FREE), a sole proprietorship in Greece ('we'). It describes how we process personal data on the app.pestify.gr platform and in the Pestify mobile applications.

Contact: manager@pestify.gr

1. When we are the controller and when we are not

This distinction is essential and precedes all other information.

We act as the Data Controller only for: (a) account, billing and contact data relating to our subscribing businesses and their representatives; and (b) technical security data of the platform.

We act as the Data Processor for all data entered into the platform by each subscribing business, including customer records, locations, service history, photographs and technician details. The business itself, rather than us, is the Data Controller for that data. We process it solely on its instructions and only to operate the service.

Are you a customer of a pest control business looking for your own data? Contact the business serving you. It decides what information it keeps about you and for how long. We provide the technical platform and cannot address the substance of your request.

2. Scope

This Policy covers the app.pestify.gr platform and the Pestify mobile applications (iOS and Android).

3. The app.pestify.gr platform and mobile applications

3.1 Data held on the platform

• Accounts: business name or full name, username, email, tax identification number (AFM) and property registry number (AMA) where entered
• Locations: addresses of the premises where services are performed
• Operations: service records, reports and visit scheduling
• Technicians: full name and details entered by their employer
• Images: floor plans and drawings uploaded by an administrator; photographs attached by technicians to their reports; photographs uploaded by end customers when requesting emergency service

We do not process payment data. No transactions take place through the platform.

3.2 Roles

When a pest control business enters personal data into the platform, such as homeowners' names, that business is the Data Controller and Christos Pamporis (PEST FREE) is the Data Processor.

Individuals should direct requests concerning their data to that business. If such a request reaches us, we do not respond to its substance; we forward it to the business within five business days and provide the technical assistance it needs.

3.3 Legal basis

For the operation of our subscribers' accounts, processing is based on the performance of our contract with them.

For data entered by subscribers, we do not rely on our own legal basis: we act on their instructions and they, as controllers, determine the legal basis.

3.4 Security

• Encryption in transit and at rest
• Secure password hashing; passwords are never stored in plain text
• Role-based access control applying the principle of least privilege
• Logical separation of each business's data; no business can view another's data
• Logging of administrative actions
• Backups and an incident response process

3.5 Retention

Platform data is retained for the duration of the relationship with the subscribing business. After that relationship ends, the data remains available for retrieval for thirty (30) days and is then permanently deleted, including from backups, unless the law requires retention.

4. Infrastructure and service providers

• Railway Corporation (USA): application and database hosting; stored within the EEA — Netherlands.
• Google Cloud Platform: data center; Netherlands (EEA).

We do not sell, rent or trade personal data. We do not use it to train artificial intelligence systems.

5. Transfers outside the EEA

Platform data is stored within the European Economic Area.

However, the hosting provider is a company established in the United States, and its personnel may remotely access data for technical support, maintenance and security. This access is covered by the European Commission's Standard Contractual Clauses incorporated into our agreement with the provider, and is accompanied by limits to the minimum necessary access and activity logging.

6. Cookies

The platform uses strictly necessary cookies for secure login and session management.

7. Your rights

Depending on the circumstances, you may request access to your data, rectification, erasure, restriction of processing or data portability, object to processing, or withdraw consent where processing is based on consent.

Where to send your request: manager@pestify.gr for matters concerning your subscriber account or technical security data. For data held about you by a pest control business, contact that business (see section 1).

You also have the right to lodge a complaint with the Hellenic Data Protection Authority — Kifisias 1–3, 115 23 Athens, www.dpa.gr, +30 210 6475600.

8. Changes

We may update this Policy. The current version is displayed in the application with its date.

termsOfUse.title: Terms of Use
termsOfUse.content:
Terms of Use

Version v1.0 — Effective from 18/09/2026

These Terms govern access to and use of the app.pestify.gr platform and the Pestify mobile applications, operated by Christos Pamporis (PEST FREE), a sole proprietorship in Greece.

Are you a customer of a pest control business using the customer portal? Separate Customer Portal Terms apply to you, rather than these Terms.

1. What the platform is

Pestify is a software tool for pest control businesses: it helps manage customer records, schedule services, maintain records and service sheets, generate reports and organize daily operations.

2. Who may use it

The platform is available exclusively to businesses. By using it, you confirm that you are acting in a professional capacity and are authorized to bind the business you represent.

3. Account

You provide accurate and complete details and keep them up to date. You keep your credentials confidential and are responsible for every action taken through them. You notify us immediately of any unauthorized use.

We may suspend or terminate an account in the event of a breach or where necessary for the security of the platform.

4. Subscriptions

Subscription terms — price, duration, usage limits and payment — are set out in the separately signed subscription agreement. If these Terms conflict with that agreement, the subscription agreement prevails.

Prices exclude VAT unless stated otherwise. Nonpayment may result in suspension of access.

5. Acceptable use

You must not:

• grant access to anyone other than your authorized users or share credentials;
• resell, lease or make the platform available to third parties, or present it as your own service;
• copy, modify or create derivative works, or reproduce its structure or interface to develop a competing product;
• reverse engineer it by any method, attempt to access its source code or circumvent technical protection measures; this does not restrict acts permitted by mandatory law that cannot be excluded by contract;
• use automated means or conduct security testing without our written authorization;
• enter unlawful or harmful content or malware;
• use the platform for covert surveillance of individuals or any unlawful activity.

You are solely responsible for the lawfulness of the data you enter and for having a lawful basis for processing it.

6. Intellectual property

The software, code, design, interface, documentation, trademarks and logos belong to Christos Pamporis (PEST FREE). You receive a limited, nonexclusive and nontransferable license to use them for your business's internal needs.

The data you enter remains yours. We do not exploit or sell it, or use it to train artificial intelligence systems.

7. Data protection

For data you enter on the platform, you are the Data Controller and we are the Data Processor. We process it only on your instructions and to provide the service. Detailed terms appear in the Data Processing Addendum to the subscription agreement.

You handle individuals' requests concerning their data. If such requests reach us, we forward them to you.

8. Availability

We make reasonable efforts to keep the service available, but do not guarantee uninterrupted or error-free availability. Maintenance, security updates and technical failures may occur. We reserve the right to modify or replace features.

9. Your review remains necessary

Pestify is an organizational tool. It does not provide legal, regulatory, public health or scientific advice, and it does not certify anything.

You check every service sheet, report and certificate before signing it or presenting it to an authority. Compliance with biocides legislation, required record-keeping and the accuracy of entries are solely your responsibility.

Using the platform does not relieve you of the obligation to retain your own copies of records you are legally required to keep.

10. Liability

The platform is provided 'as is'. We do not guarantee that it will meet specialized procedures that have not been agreed in writing.

Our total liability is limited to the subscription fees for the twelve (12) months preceding the event giving rise to the damage. We are not liable for lost profits, loss of customers or reputation, indirect or consequential damages, or damage resulting from your failure to retain your own copies.

This limitation does not apply to intentional misconduct or gross negligence, injury to life, bodily integrity or health, or limit rights conferred by mandatory data protection law.

11. Force majeure

We are not liable for failure to perform caused by events beyond our reasonable control — natural disasters, war, government action, widespread power or internet outages, large-scale cyberattacks or failure of a critical third-party provider.

12. Termination

We may suspend or terminate access for a breach of these Terms, nonpayment, a serious security risk or where required by law.

Upon termination, access ends. Your data remains available for retrieval for thirty (30) days and is then permanently deleted. We do not charge a fee for moving to another provider.

13. Confidentiality

Each party keeps the other's nonpublic business information confidential. This obligation continues after termination.

14. Third-party services

The platform depends on hosting and infrastructure providers identified in the Privacy Policy. We are not liable for interruptions attributable solely to those providers or to public networks outside our reasonable control.

15. Amendments

We may update these Terms for an objectively justified reason. Material changes will be notified thirty (30) days before taking effect. If a change materially worsens your position, you may terminate within that notice period.

16. Governing law

Greek law applies. The courts of [Thessaloniki] have exclusive jurisdiction over any dispute.

17. Contact
